name: Notify User
description: Send a message to an entry in the address book: a person on their messaging channel (e.g. Telegram or email), or a device that speaks it out loud (e.g. a voice satellite). Use it to tell someone something proactively - when you run autonomously your normal reply text is NOT delivered anywhere. To reach a recipient, pass 'to' with its name and optionally 'channel': the name is looked up in the address book. Every listed name is reachable, devices included. NEVER invent a numeric id. A subject goes in 'subject' (never inside 'text'); files go in 'attachments' as paths (never pasted into 'text').

subject.description: Optional subject line. On email it is the Subject header (and starts a new thread); on chat channels it becomes the first line of the message. Do NOT write the subject inside 'text'.

attachments.description: Optional files to send along, as paths in the workspace (relative to it, or the absolute path a tool printed when it created the file). Max 5 files, 15 MB each. Email attaches them; Telegram sends each as a photo or document; a voice device cannot carry files and the result says so.

to.description: Who to send it to: a name from the address book — a person, or a device such as a speaker. Pick one of the listed values when this parameter has them (all of them are valid recipients), otherwise write the name and the error will list who exists. "all" sends to every contact on that channel: use it only when you were asked to tell everyone. Omit to use the agent's configured target.

channel.description: Which messaging channel to use. Only needed when more than one is configured.

binding_id.description: Advanced: the exact bot to send through. Prefer 'channel'. LEAVE THIS ARGUMENT OUT to use the agent's configured target — do not pass the word "default" or any placeholder.

chat_id.description: Advanced: the exact chat id, when you already know it. Prefer 'to', which wins over this one and over the agent's configured target. Several recipients: comma-separated. LEAVE THIS ARGUMENT OUT to use the agent's configured target — do not pass the word "default" or any placeholder.
